versions.name: Download file from Alibaba Cloud OSS
versions.description: Download one object from an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket with ossutil v2 — the download counterpart of buz/oss-upload. Dual engine: docker unpacks into the Runner workspace; engine: ssh (set `host:`) downloads directly on each target host (ossutil required there). AK/SK are masked inputs (digest-pinned image for the docker context).
versions.description_zh: 使用 ossutil v2 从阿里云 OSS 存储桶下载单个对象到 Buz 工作区——buz/oss-upload 的下载对称版。AK/SK 以 masked 输入传入 digest 锁定的 oss-tools 镜像。
versions.author: buz maintainers
